messages:
maya: Heads-up — CI started failing in docs build after the last push, mkdocs output shows KeyError during TOC generation.

maya: Full CI run: https://ci.redwood.example/teams/docs/1298

sam: Saw that. Looks like the TOC slugifier produced an empty anchor from a list block.

tom: Usually indicates odd indentation or trailing spaces in list items. Docusaurus and mkdocs behave differently on those.

erica: Where exactly? can you paste the snippet?

maya: pages/guides/deploying.md around the checklist. There was a fragment like:

```
- Verify infra.  
- Start cluster.  
  - wait for nodes
```

maya: Those two trailing spaces create a hard break; combined with a blank indented line the slugifier emits an empty token and the resolver trips.

sam: Wow, who knew two spaces would break our TOC. :grimacing:

tom: Quick mitigation: strip trailing spaces and remove the extra indent. Long-term: add a pre-commit normalizer and enable mkdocs strict mode so builds fail early.

erica: I'll open a tiny PR to strip trailing spaces in the offending files and enable `mkdocs build --strict` in CI.

docs-bot: @erica opened PR #2478 — "docs: remove trailing hard-breaks in lists + enable strict mkdocs" — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2478

ci-bot: docs CI started for PR #2478 — running mkdocs build --strict

ci-bot: docs CI ✅ build succeeded (mkdocs build --strict) — all checks passed

maya: Merging PR into main. Deploy will follow.

maya: Deployed to staging — https://staging.docs.redwood.example/guides/deploying.html

sam: Confirmed the previous broken anchor is fixed on staging. Links and TOC render correctly now.

erica: Added a CONTRIBUTING note recommending pre-commit normalizer and avoiding trailing spaces in lists.

tom: Also added an issue to track adding a pre-commit hook for whitespace normalization and a lint check: #108

maya: Nice. Closing this thread — thanks all :tada:
